inheritance: Global Common Core + Market Archetype + Scope Extension
scope_contract: Every Scope inherits common decisions, cross-scope metrics, evidence semantics, rights/freshness/provenance controls and NOT_VERIFIED behavior; Scope entries define distinct market grammar and irreplaceable question.

scopes.name: Designer Toys
scopes.question: Is this an authentic edition-correct artist object, and how scarce/liquid is this exact release?

scopes.name: Die-cast & Scale Models
scopes.question: Which maker/scale/edition/packaging variant is this, and what is its condition-adjusted market?

scopes.name: Vintage & Character Toys
scopes.question: Is this period-correct, complete and authentic, and how rare is survival in comparable condition?

scopes.name: Construction & Mechanical Sets
scopes.question: Which exact version is this, how complete/original is it, and what premium does completeness command?

scopes.name: Mechanical Watches
scopes.question: Do visually similar references represent the same collectible once originality, configuration and condition are controlled?

scopes.name: Vintage & Digital Watches
scopes.question: Which generation/configuration is this, is electronics/originality intact, and is scarcity structural or nostalgic?

scopes.name: Fine Jewelry
scopes.question: Is attribution/material/provenance defensible and what comparable market exists for this exact quality tier?

scopes.name: Designer Jewelry
scopes.question: Which designer/collection/era is this, is it authentic, and how strong are canon and secondary liquidity?

scopes.name: Collector Cars
scopes.question: Is the valuation gap explained by specification, originality, provenance, restoration and market liquidity?

scopes.name: Modern Classics
scopes.question: Which specification/mileage/condition combinations are becoming collectible rather than ordinary used vehicles?

scopes.name: Collector Motorcycles
scopes.question: Are frame/engine/specification and restoration correct, and how does originality affect scarcity and liquidity?

scopes.name: Automotive Memorabilia
scopes.question: Can provenance to marque/driver/event be defended and how does that affect rarity and price?

scopes.name: Sneakers
scopes.question: What is the exact SKU/colorway/size/release, is it authentic, and what is size-condition-adjusted liquidity?

scopes.name: Handbags
scopes.question: Is the bag authentic and correctly identified by model/material/season, and what drives regional/condition premium?

scopes.name: Designer Garments
scopes.question: Is this the exact collection/runway/archive piece, and how do provenance, condition and cultural canon affect value?

scopes.name: Eyewear
scopes.question: Is this the correct model/era/material and does design or cultural association create durable collectible demand?

scopes.name: Seating
scopes.question: Is this authentic period/maker production or later production/restoration, and how does that alter value?

scopes.name: Tables & Storage
scopes.question: Which maker/edition/material/period is this and how do originality, restoration and provenance affect comparability?

scopes.name: Lighting
scopes.question: Is designer/maker/model attribution correct and are electrical/restoration changes value-destructive or acceptable?

scopes.name: Decorative Design Objects
scopes.question: Is attribution/edition/material defensible and where does the object sit within design canon and market depth?

scopes.name: Cameras & Lenses
scopes.question: Which serial/revision/configuration is this, what is optical/mechanical condition, and how does rarity affect liquidity?

scopes.name: Hi-Fi & Audio
scopes.question: Which version/circuit/component configuration is original and how do service/condition affect audiophile market value?

scopes.name: Vintage Computing
scopes.question: Which revision/configuration is this, how complete/working/original is it, and what is tech-historical scarcity?

scopes.name: Collectible Electronics & Devices
scopes.question: When does a device move from used commodity to collectible based on design, variant and survival state?

scopes.name: Video Games & Consoles
scopes.question: Which release/region/version/seal/grade is this and what is population-adjusted scarcity and liquidity?

scopes.name: Vinyl & Recorded Music
scopes.question: Which exact pressing/matrix/region/edition is this and what premium comes from pressing and condition?

scopes.name: Musical Instruments & Artist Gear
scopes.question: Is serial/specification/originality correct and is artist provenance defensible enough to change market value?

scopes.name: Film / TV Props & Screen Objects
scopes.question: Can screen-use provenance be established and does scene/character significance create durable scarcity premium?

scopes.name: Trading Cards
scopes.question: What is the exact printing/language/variant/grade and what is grade-population-adjusted scarcity and liquidity?

scopes.name: Comic Books
scopes.question: Which issue/printing/variant/grade/restoration state is this and how scarce/liquid is it relative to census?

scopes.name: Sports Memorabilia
scopes.question: Can athlete/event/game-use/signature provenance be independently defended and how does that affect marketability?

scopes.name: Historical & Cultural Memorabilia
scopes.question: Can provenance/attribution/event linkage withstand institutional scrutiny and what market exists for comparable significance?
